contractDraftId.title: Contract Draft ID
contractDraftId.description: Contract draft ID from the Contract Agent, empty when not allowed

decision.title: Decision
decision.description: Approved, VP Approval Required, Not Allowed or Needs Info

errorMessage.title: Error Message
errorMessage.description: What went wrong if the review failed, or a note that the decision was not saved on the Opportunity

errorType.title: Error Type
errorType.description: Error category if the review failed, for example OPPORTUNITY_NOT_ACCESSIBLE or MISSING_DEAL_ID

isSuccess.title: Success
isSuccess.description: True when the Deal Desk returned a decision

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: Full Deal Desk reply: margin impact, credit report (PAN masked) and contract terms
